targets.title: Training the approximate number system improves math proficiency
targets.evidence_quote: Consequently, we attempted more precise replications of Park & Brannon, 2013, 2014 in Experiment 3 (approximate arithmetic training compared to numeral ordering training) and a preregistered replication in Experiment 4 (approximate arithmetic training compared to approximate number comparison training).
targets.outcome_quote: The original goal of the current study was to replicate the finding that non-symbolic approximate arithmetic training improves symbolic arithmetic fluency, and to build on this finding by probing the mechanism of the transfer effect. However, we were unable to replicate the original finding across four independent experiments.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall failure verdict applies to both explicitly re-tested Park and Brannon papers; the subsequent pooled analysis does not change it.
